task.title: Relics: link relics and parts to tasks
task.description:
A relic is a new kind of record in Workbook, separate from tasks. It holds specs, plans, decisions, transcripts and similar material, with the same history and sharing that tasks have. A relic has a title, a type, an author, links, and content made of named parts.

This story lets a relic, or one part of a relic, link to a task, and lets the link be followed from either end.

## The link

```json
{ "id": "01M9…L",
  "from": "<part of this relic, or omitted for the whole relic>",
  "to": { "task": "WB-01M2…" },
  "rel": "implemented-by" }
```

- A link is stored once, on the relic it starts from, in `links.json`. Nothing is written on the task, and tasks do not change format.
- Every link has its own ID. Links added or removed on both sides of a sync all apply, the way labels and assignments do.
- `rel` is a relationship name. Until the default schemas story lands, any name within the 100-byte limit is accepted.
- The target must exist when the link is added. If the task is later deleted, the link stays and is shown as pointing at something removed.
- A link points at its target as it is now.
- Limits: 2,000 links per relic, checked only when a link is added. The link format leaves room for a relic or part target and for a pointer of up to 512 bytes, which the relic-to-relic story adds.

## Following a link from both ends

- The local index keeps every link searchable by either end. "What points at this task?" is one lookup, with no crawl of relics and no background job.
- `relic update <relic> --link <task> [--from <part>] --rel R` and `--unlink <link>`.
- `relic show` lists a relic's links.
- `relic list --linked-to <task>` lists the relics and parts that point at a task.
- `workbook show <task>` gains a list of the relics and parts linked to that task, in text and in `--json`.

## Done when

- A link added in one clone is visible from the task in another clone after a sync.
- Rebuilding the index from the refs restores every reverse lookup.
- Concurrent link adds and removes from two clones all survive.
- A link to a deleted task is shown as removed and does not fail any command.
- `workbook show <task>` output for a task with no links is unchanged.

## Not in this story

Links to relics and parts, pointers, and checking relationship names against a list.

## Where the design is

The approved design is "Workbook Relics Design" (2026-11-21). It is kept out of the repository. Until "Relics: teach agents to use relics and store the design as the first relic" is done, an untracked copy sits at `specs/2026-11-21-relics-design.html` in Dylan's checkout. After that, read the relic. This description carries what the story needs, and the design wins where the two disagree.
